an6.74:2.6: sattamo → dutiyo (sya-all) | dutiyo → devatāggo sattamo (bj: machasaṁ, sīmu, aṭṭhakathā) | sattamo → dutiyo (cck: syā. ka.)
an6.74:3.2: saṅgaṇikārāmadevatā samādhisakkhibhabbaṁ balaṁ tajjhānā → devatā satisakkhibalaṁ taṁ jhānaṁ (sya-all)
an6.74:3.4: duveti → duve pi cā ti (pts) | duveti → anāgāmī arahaṁ ca mitta devatā so vata sakkhi balataṁ jhānaṁ ca apara duvepi crāti (bj: sīmu)
